scope: Six map release descriptions, four guide phrases and one destination label only; unreviewed. Existing native entries, course and farming instructions remain unchanged.

entries.source: New map legends use spare margin space for larger, clearer lettering.

drafts.zu: Izincazelo zezimpawu zemephu ezintsha zisebenzisa isikhala esiseceleni ukuze umbhalo ube mkhulu futhi ucace.
drafts.st: Ditlhaloso tse ntjha tsa matshwao a dimmapa di sebedisa sebaka se se nang letho mahlakoreng hore mongolo o be moholo le ho hlaka.
drafts.ts: Tinhlamuselo letintshwa ta swikombiso swa mepe ti tirhisa ndhawu leyi nga tirhisiwiki etlhelo leswaku marito ma va makulu ni ku hlayeka kahle.
drafts.ve: Ṱhalutshedzo ntswa dza zwiga zwa mepe dzi shumisa tshikhala tshi sa shumiswiho thungo uri maṅwalwa a vhe mahulwane nahone a vhalege zwavhuḓi.

entries.source: Paper base maps show each building you traced, with separate building names.

drafts.zu: Amamephu ayisisekelo asephepheni abonisa zonke izakhiwo ozidwebe, namagama azo ahlukene.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa motheo tsa pampiri di bontsha moaho o mong le o mong oo o o thaletseng, ka mabitso a arohaneng a meaho.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya masungulo ya le papileni yi komba muako wun’wana ni wun’wana lowu u nga wu dirowa, ni mavito ya miako lama hambaneke.
drafts.ve: Mimepe ya mutheo ya kha bammbiri i sumbedza tshifhaṱo tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshe na tshi ola, na madzina o fhambanaho a zwifhaṱo.

entries.source: Saved maps stay available; create new drawings to see these improvements.

drafts.zu: Amamephu agciniwe ahlala etholakala; dala imidwebo emisha ukuze ubone lezi zinguquko.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tse bolokilweng di ntse di fumaneha; etsa metako e metjha ho bona dintlafatso tsena.
drafts.ts: Mimepe leyi hlayisiweke ya ha kumeka; endla swidirowiwa leswintshwa ku vona ku antswisiwa loku.
drafts.ve: Mimepe yo vhulungwaho i kha ḓi wanala; olani mimepe miswa uri ni vhone khwiniso idzi.

entries.source: All nine map sheets use the same legend box, fonts and spacing.

drafts.zu: Wonke amakhasi ayisishiyagalolunye amamephu asebenzisa ibhokisi elifanayo lezimpawu, amafonti nezikhala.
drafts.st: Maqephe ohle a robong a dimmapa a sebedisa lebokose le tshwanang la matshwao, mekgwa ya mongolo le dikgeo.
drafts.ts: Mapheji hinkwawo ya nkaye ya mimepe ma tirhisa bokisi rin’we ra swikombiso, tifonto ni swivandla leswi fanaka.
drafts.ve: Masiaṱari oṱhe a ṱahe a mimepe a shumisa bogisi ḽithihi ḽa zwiga, fonto na zwikhala zwi fanaho.

entries.source: New drawings keep the legend on the right; your saved maps stay available.

drafts.zu: Imidwebo emisha igcina incazelo yezimpawu ngakwesokudla; amamephu akho agciniwe ayatholakala.
drafts.st: Metako e metjha e boloka tlhaloso ya matshwao ka ho le letona; dimmapa tse bolokilweng di ntse di fumaneha.
drafts.ts: Swidirowiwa leswintshwa swi veka nhlamuselo ya swikombiso exineneni; mimepe ya wena leyi hlayisiweke ya ha kumeka.
drafts.ve: Zwifanyiso zwiswa zwi vhea ṱhalutshedzo ya zwiga kha tsha u ḽa; mimepe yaṋu yo vhulungwaho i kha ḓi wanala.

entries.source: Long map headings wrap inside their legend box.

drafts.zu: Izihloko ezinde zemephu zihlukaniswa ngemigqa ngaphakathi kwebhokisi lezimpawu.
drafts.st: Dihlooho tse telele tsa dimmapa di arolwa ka mela ka hara lebokose la tlhaloso ya matshwao.
drafts.ts: Tinhlokomhaka to leha ta mepe ti aviwa hi tilayini endzeni ka bokisi ra swikombiso.
drafts.ve: Ṱhoho ndapfu dza mepe dzi khethekanywa nga mitaladzi ngomu ha bogisi ḽa zwiga.

drafts.st: Hlahloba mongolo o motjha wa mmapa

entries.source: Create a free exact map. Check the larger key and the buildings you traced.

drafts.zu: Dala imephu yamahhala enembile. Hlola incazelo yezimpawu enkulu nezakhiwo ozidwebe.
drafts.st: Etsa mmapa o nepahetseng wa mahala. Hlahloba tlhaloso e kgolo ya matshwao le meaho eo o e thaletseng.
drafts.ts: Endla mepe lowu kongomeke wa mahala. Kamba nhlamuselo leyikulu ya swikombiso ni miako leyi u nga yi dirowa.
drafts.ve: Itani mepe wo teaho wa mahala. Ṱolani ṱhalutshedzo khulwane ya zwiga na zwifhaṱo zwe na zwi ola.

entries.source: Check the maps in your site report

drafts.st: Hlahloba dimmapa tlalehong ya sebaka sa hao
drafts.ts: Kamba mimepe eka xiviko xa ndhawu ya wena
drafts.ve: Ṱolani mimepe kha muvhigo wa fhethu haṋu

entries.source: Review each included map before exporting. Saved older drawings stay available.

drafts.zu: Buyekeza imephu ngayinye efakiwe ngaphambi kokuthekelisa. Imidwebo emidala egciniwe isatholakala.
drafts.st: Hlahloba mmapa o mong le o mong o kenyelleditsweng pele o o romela kantle. Metako ya kgale e bolokilweng e ntse e fumaneha.
drafts.ts: Kamba mepe wun’wana ni wun’wana lowu katsiweke u nga si wu humesa. Swidirowiwa swa khale leswi hlayisiweke swa ha kumeka.
drafts.ve: Sedzulusani mepe muṅwe na muṅwe wo katelwaho musi ni sa athu u bvisa faela. Zwifanyiso zwa kale zwo vhulungwaho zwi kha ḓi wanala.
